notInstalled.title: Needs the RouteLink plugin
notInstalled.message: Install the plugin on this router to see how much each device uses, live and over time.

notRunning.title: The plugin is not running
notRunning.message: It is installed but its service is stopped.

tooOld.title: The plugin is too old
tooOld.message: This app needs a newer version of the plugin.

tooNew.title: Please update the app
tooNew.message: The plugin on this router is newer than this app understands.

noPermission.title: This account can't use the plugin
noPermission.message: Sign in as root, or grant this account “luci-app-routelink” in LuCI under System → Administration.

banner.accounting: Connection accounting (nf_conntrack_acct) is off: device traffic reads 0.
banner.offload: Hardware offloading is on: offloaded traffic may not be counted.
banner.time: The router's clock is not synchronised yet; data stays in memory until it is.
banner.nlbwmon: nlbwmon is running and resets the connection counters this plugin reads.

consequences.stops: nlbwmon stops and won't start at boot; its own statistics stop growing.
consequences.undo: Turn it back on any time under More → Services.

page.about: Runs on the router: per-device traffic history, Wi-Fi signal of the stations it serves, latency probes and an outage log, speed tests, speed limits and data quotas, a DNS log, and push notices sent by the router itself.
page.requirements: Needs about {{size}} of free space, the root account, and a router that can reach the official OpenWrt package servers (for dependencies).
page.mirrorHint: Optional. A prefix put in front of GitHub download links, for networks where GitHub is slow.

consequences.deleted: The plugin's history of every device is deleted from the router.

consequences.packages: The plugin's packages are removed; traffic pages show the install button again.

install.title: Install the plugin on {{name}}?

consequences.packages: Three packages are installed on the router: the service, its LuCI pages and their Chinese translation.
consequences.dependencies: The router downloads missing dependencies from the official OpenWrt servers.
consequences.rpcd: rpcd reloads while installing; an open LuCI page may need a refresh.

install.doneMessage: Traffic statistics start now; history builds up from here.

failed.not-root: Installing needs the root account. Sign in as root and try again.
failed.no-helper: This router has no LuCI package manager. Install luci-app-package-manager (or luci-app-opkg) first.
failed.unsupported-release: There is no plugin build for this OpenWrt release yet.
failed.unsupported-arch: There is no plugin build for this router's processor yet.
failed.no-space: Not enough free space: about {{need}} needed, {{free}} left.
failed.download: The download failed. Check the phone's internet connection, or set a download mirror.
failed.checksum: A downloaded file was damaged. Try again, or use another mirror.
failed.upload: Couldn't copy the packages to the router.
failed.lists: The router couldn't update its package lists. It needs internet access.
failed.dependencies: The router couldn't install what the plugin needs: {{detail}}. It needs internet access.
failed.install: The package manager reported an error.
failed.verify: The packages are installed, but the plugin didn't start.
